summary: Collections removed from the Ansible 10 package: community.azure, community.sap, gluster.gluster, hpe.nimble, netapp.aws, netapp.azure, netapp.elementsw, netapp.um_info and purestorage.fusion, with their last included versions.
questions: Which collections were removed in Ansible 10?
Is gluster.gluster still in the Ansible package?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from the Ansible 10 package (last included version):
- community.azure (2.0.0)
- community.sap (2.0.0)
- gluster.gluster (1.0.2)
- hpe.nimble (1.1.4)
- netapp.aws (21.7.1)
- netapp.azure (21.10.1)
- netapp.elementsw (21.7.0)
- netapp.um_info (21.8.1)
- purestorage.fusion (1.6.0)
